subject: Evaluation scenarios & week-by-week sprint canvas — starter templates
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Zhou <clara.zhou@edgetech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation scenarios & week-by-week sprint canvas — starter templates

Hi Clara,

Great to meet yesterday — thanks again for the time. As promised, attaching an initial set of artifacts to seed the evaluation: a GDoc with three candidate evaluation scenarios (integration, latency/cost, and acceptance tests), a lightweight week-by-week sprint canvas (slides), and a short acceptance-criteria checklist.

High-level ask: if you can review the scenarios and mark which two you want to prioritize for the pilot (integration smoke + cost/latency run are usually the most telling), we’ll draft the MAP with owners and dates and share a live GDoc for co-edit.

Proposed next steps:
- You: indicate prioritized scenarios and procurement contacts (if any) by EOD Wed
- We: convert prioritized scenarios into a 21-day MAP with milestones and test owners
- Schedule: 60-minute kickoff next week to align owners + runbook

Attachments: EdgeTech_Eval_Scenarios_v1.gdoc (seed), WeekByWeek_SprintCanvas_v1.slides, acceptance-criteria-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll update the draft MAP after I hear back.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Clara Zhou <clara.zhou@edgetech.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeTech Procurement <procure@edgetech.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation scenarios & week-by-week sprint canvas — starter templates

Thanks Michael — appreciate the quick turn. I shared the GDoc with our engineering lead (Raj Patel) and procurement on cc. A couple quick notes: 

- The integration scenario looks good; can you add an acceptance criterion for data isolation and KV cache persistence?
- We’d like a short section that spells out what constitutes an acceptable latency window for our 95th percentile (we use < 200ms for simple prompt paths).
- Procurement will need estimated committed GPU hours and a simple pricing example to accelerate approval.

I’m available Wed 11–12 or Thu afternoon for the kickoff. Can you add Raj explicitly to the MAP draft?

Clara
VP Product | EdgeTech Solutions
clara.zhou@edgetech.com

Michael — copying a few quick ops suggestions before we hand the doc across:

- Add a "technical validation" lane in the MAP for week 1: environment checklist (VPC peering, KMS keys, model variant selection), week 2: smoke tests with sample dataset, week 3: performance run + cost analysis.
- Include explicit owner for each acceptance item (e.g., eng lead, infra lead, Redwood SE).
- We should bake a fallback policy into the MAP: if run exceeds latency threshold, auto-fall back to a quantized/cheaper model variant and record metrics.

I drafted a few sample ownership rows and pasted them into the attached GDoc seed (EdgeTech_Eval_Scenarios_v1.gdoc). If Clara confirms Raj, we should invite him to co-edit and I’ll add the infra checklist.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Clara / Raj / procurement team — thanks for the notes. I updated the live GDoc with: 
- added acceptance rows for data isolation and KV persistence
- included a 95th percentile latency threshold row set to 200ms (we can tune)
- appended a one-slide pricing sketch (committed GPU hours and ballpark cost) in the slides deck

Link to draft MAP (co-edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-EdgeTech-Eval

Proposed tentative schedule (if we commit to the two priority scenarios):
Week 0 (prep): infra access, GCP/VPC peering, key exchange
Week 1 (tech validation): smoke tests + integration scenario owner signoff
Week 2 (scale): latency/cost runs and cost breakdowns
Week 3 (acceptance): run acceptance tests and finalize MAP acceptance checklist

I penciled in the 60-minute kickoff for Thu 15:00 PT (calendar invite sent) — if that works I’ll lock it.

Attachments: WeekByWeek_SprintCanvas_v1.slides (updated pricing slide), acceptance-criteria-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Michael
